Remarks

A webhook endpoint is public, so the signature is the whole of its authentication: an unverified body is an anonymous stranger's, and acting on one would let anybody mark a bill paid.

Methods

Verify(string, string?, PaymentWebhookEndpointType)

The event, when the signature matches; a failure when it does not.

public IResult<PaymentEventDTO> Verify(string payload, string? signature, PaymentWebhookEndpointType endpoint = PaymentWebhookEndpointType.Platform)

Parameters

payload string

The request body exactly as received. Re-serializing it — even into an equivalent document — breaks the signature, so it has to be read as a string before anything parses it.

signature string

The signature header the provider sent it with.

endpoint PaymentWebhookEndpointType

Which endpoint it arrived on, for providers that sign each one separately.
